articles.paragraph: Every item in our menu is freshly cooked and prepared with atmost care using unadulterated ingredients. We at New Era beleive in the philosophy “fresh is always the best”. The ambience of our Chestnut Hill restaurant is very similar to our other restaurants; peaceful, comfortable, and relaxing.                              If you are looking for a unique lunch or dining experience, please come and give New Era Indian Cuisine a try. We assure that we wont disappoint you.
